steps.message: Standards Engineering needs the witness-test scope and scheduling package for the municipal arrays that need one, and the list of arrays the System Operations Center can be asked to release as the record stands at 07/14/2025, before the 08/15/2025 League response. The batch is covered by the municipal commissioning checklists, Checklist_Cravenwood_High.pdf through Checklist_Tresbay_Community_Center.pdf, and by the DER Program's commissioning records, including the Program Office's case tracking and its commissioning wiki. Establish which arrays are still in scope for the batch on that date. For each array in scope, determine whether the inverter or power conversion equipment actually installed there is carried on the current Certified Equipment List, and issue the package: for each array that is not carried, the tests to be performed and their basis, who performs and witnesses them, and what has to be on file first. The waiver disposition itself stays with Standards Engineering and is not yours to make. Log a scheduling item in the case tracking for each array that is not carried, record the batch determination on the case, and close the case once the arrays named in the package and the scheduling items standing on it agree. Return your work as a single Word document named Municipal_Witness_Test_Package.docx, filed in the Program Office's municipal commissioning folder in the document store, giving each determination with the basis you relied on, and the call made one way or the other on carriage.
